# Data Parrot MCP changelog

## [2026-10-20](https://dataparrot.ai/docs/changelog/2026-10-20-mcp-forecast-notes)

Retrieve Forecast Notes with Deal details and Forecast Status, including saved note history on request. Forecast summaries now include won actuals when comparing revenue and commitments against existing goals.

## [2026-09-22](https://dataparrot.ai/docs/changelog/2026-09-22-mcp-transcripts)

Retrieve transcripts for individual meetings and calls through the Data Parrot MCP Server, with speaker labels and timestamps where available.

## [2026-09-09](https://dataparrot.ai/docs/changelog/2026-09-09-forecast-status-classification)

AI classifies your team's Forecast Status values, and connected AI assistants can use Forecast Status through MCP.

## [2026-09-03](https://dataparrot.ai/docs/changelog/2026-09-03-data-parrot-cursor-plugin)

Install the public Data Parrot plugin from GitHub to use the Data Parrot MCP Server in Cursor.

## [2026-07-24](https://dataparrot.ai/docs/changelog/2026-07-24-data-parrot-mcp-access)

The Data Parrot MCP Server now searches more precisely, handles larger results, shows supporting evidence more clearly, and includes updated prompts and access controls.

## [2026-07-15](https://dataparrot.ai/docs/changelog/2026-07-15-data-parrot-mcp)

Connect compatible AI assistants to Data Parrot through the new Data Parrot MCP Server.
